scripts.text:
[Towner]
I love cacti. They're
the most beautiful plants
in the desert. Sometimes,
they're the only signs of
life in a barren land.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我喜欢仙人掌。它们是沙漠中最美丽的植物。有时，它们是这片荒芜土地上唯一的生命迹象。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you feel a stirring
in your heart when you
look at a cactus, you
must appreciate the
desert's true beauty.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你看着仙人掌时心中泛起涟漪，那你一定懂得欣赏沙漠真正的美。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, I don't know if
I can find anyone that
finds the desert as
wonderful and enchanting
as I do. It's a pity, really.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，我不知道能不能找到像我一样觉得沙漠美妙迷人的人。真是遗憾啊。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Welcome to Veins, the
town near the Temple of
Cheshrumnir. You may think
this is a dreary desert town,
but you'll find that it's as
lively as any other place.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
欢迎来到伯仁斯，瑟斯隆尼勒神殿附近的小镇。你可能觉得这是个沉闷的沙漠小镇，但你会发现这里和其他地方一样充满活力。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Sure, there are a few
characters in town, like
that cactus loving loony
over there, but not everyone's
like him. There's lots of nice,
kind people that you can meet.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
当然，镇上有些怪人，比如那边那个爱仙人掌的疯子，但并不是每个人都像他那样。这里有很多友善的好人等着你去结识。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well then, I hope that
you enjoy your stay~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
那么，希望你在这里过得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Geez, why is our weapon
shop so boring? Nothing
there but the same ol'
regular junk. Sad to say,
there's nothing special.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
天哪，为什么我们的武器店这么无聊？那里除了那些老掉牙的普通垃圾什么都没有。说来悲哀，没什么特别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Wouldn't it be great
if there was a shop that
sold the legendary godly
weapons? Of course, that's
asking a bit too much.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果有一家出售传说级神器的商店那该多好啊？当然，这要求有点太高了。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Though we're in the
middle of the desert,
our enemies continue
to threaten us. Fools!
Goddess Freya will
always protect us!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
虽然我们身处沙漠中心，但敌人仍在不断威胁我们。蠢货！芙蕾雅女神会永远保护我们！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
So long as we continue to
train, Freya will watch over
us and bless us with victory
over our foes. That, friend,
is the power of faith.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
只要我们坚持训练，芙蕾雅就会守护我们，并赐予我们要战胜敌人的胜利。朋友，这就是信仰的力量。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Whoa, get out of here!
Can't you see that I'm
playing hide and go seek?!
Move before they find me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，快离开这里！你没看到我在玩捉迷藏吗？！在他们找到我之前快走开！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Gosh, where could she
be hiding? I hate being
it... There's so many places
to hide around here. There
must be someplace I haven't
checked yet... Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
天哪，她可能躲在哪里呢？我讨厌当鬼……这里有太多可以躲藏的地方了。肯定还有我没检查过的地方……让我想想……

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Praise be to Freya
for blessing me with
long life, but I wonder
if I've fully lived life.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
感谢芙蕾雅赐予我长寿，但我想知道自己是否真正活过了这一生。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I don't have any regrets
or doubts, but maybe there
are a few things I missed
out on. I guess an old man
can't help but think about
these sorts of things...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我没有任何遗憾或疑虑，但也许我错过了一些事情。我想老年人难免会思考这类事情……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Cacti are wonderful,
they're the most beautiful
plants in the desert. Yes, we
must cherish and nurture them~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
仙人掌很棒，它们是沙漠中最美丽的植物。是的，我们必须珍惜并呵护它们~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Regular cacti are 
pretty uncommon, but
I hear there's a kind of
cactus that roams the desert
and makes loud, obnoxious
noises. How can that be true?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
普通的仙人掌已经很少见了，但我听说有一种仙人掌会在沙漠中游荡，发出巨大且令人讨厌的噪音。这怎么可能是真的？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What do you want?
Sorry, but I'm just
a normal guy with normal
problems. Nothing that
I can't solve on my own.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
你想要什么？抱歉，我只是个有着普通烦恼的普通人。没有什么是我自己解决不了的。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Unless... You can do my
taxes? Pay off my mortgage?
No? Heh. Didn't think so.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
除非……你能帮我报税？还清我的房贷？不能？呵。我就知道。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What's an adventurer
doing here in such an
isolated, dreary town?
Shouldn't you be looking
for adventures? Take it from
me, this place if bo-ring.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
冒险者怎么会来到这样一个孤立、沉闷的小镇？你不应该去寻找冒险吗？听我说，这个地方很——无——聊。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Whoa, it's been a while
seen I've seen tourists
in town. You might think
there's nothing here, but
take a closer look. You
might learn something.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
哇，好久没在镇上见到游客了。你可能觉得这里什么都没有，但仔细看看。你可能会学到一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Just like people, you
can't know everything about
a place with only a glance.
If you give it a chance, I'm
sure you'll find something
to like about this town.
and try to find things that mind interest you?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
就像人一样，你无法仅凭一瞥就了解一个地方的全部。如果你给它一个机会，我相信你会发现这个城镇的可爱之处，并试着寻找让你感兴趣的事物？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What do I mean by ''a
closer look?'' Heh, you'll
see... Maybe. Hahahaha!
Oh, forget it, it's not
that important anyway.
May Freya bless you~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我说的“仔细看看”是什么意思？呵，你会看到的……也许吧。哈哈哈！哦，算了，反正也没那么重要。愿芙蕾雅保佑你~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I really want to look
inside the temple, but
it looks so scary from
the outside! I wonder
why it's like that?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我真的很想看看神殿里面，但从外面看它好可怕！我想知道为什么会这样？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Don't get me wrong:
I'd give my life in Freya's
name, but that so-called
temple just looks so strange
and suspicious. How can it
be a place of worship?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
别误会：我愿意为芙蕾雅献出生命，但那座所谓的神殿看起来太奇怪、太可疑了。那怎么能是礼拜场所呢？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I guess you can tell
from this withered tree
that our town is short
on water. I guess that's
a natural consequence of
living here in the desert...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
从这棵枯树上你就能看出来，我们镇缺水。我想这是生活在沙漠中的自然后果……

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
When I look down on
Veins from here, I've
come to realize many things.
I don't think you'd understand
no matter how much I explained.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
从这里俯瞰伯仁斯，我领悟到了许多事情。我想无论我怎么解释，你都不会理解的。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I suppose it's one of those
things that you learn with age.
Yes, there's no substitute for
experience when it comes to
some things. You'll see.
^FFFFFFYes, like secret knowledge.^000000
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我想这是那种随着年龄增长才能学到的东西。是的，在某些事情上，经验是无法替代的。你会明白的。
^FFFFFF是的，就像秘密知识一样。^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
This isn't good.
The elderly outnumber
the youth here in Veins.
We're too close to becoming
something of a retirement
community. You see it, right?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这可不好。在伯仁斯，老年人比年轻人多。我们快要变成某种退休社区了。你看到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I guess the young people
aren't content living here
since we lack a lot of the
material excitement of other
towns. They can't appreciate
what's really special here...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我想年轻人不满意住在这里，因为我们缺乏其他城镇拥有的物质刺激。他们无法欣赏这里真正特别的地方……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
People cherish water
around here, but I've
something even more
precious to me. Yes, even
more precious than water...
You guessed it--true love.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这里的人们珍视水，但我有更珍贵的东西。是的，甚至比水更珍贵……你猜对了——真爱。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
We actually started dating
here, so this place really
means a lot to me. It's my
favorite spot for spending
time with my girl. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我们实际上是在这里开始约会的，所以这个地方对我意义重大。这是我和女孩共度时光的最爱地点。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, I'm actually
a little tired of coming
here all the time. I kind
of want to try someplace
else, but I also know he
really loves coming here.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，其实我有点厌倦总是来这里了。我有点想去别的地方试试，但我也知道他真的很喜欢来这里。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
It would actually be
kind of sad if we stopped
coming here altogether.
I'm just happy so long
as he's with me~ Hoho~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果我们完全不再来这里，其实会有点伤感。只要他和我在一起，我就很开心~呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Why don't you take
a look at my goods?
I've got many things
that might interest you~
scripts.translation:
[老人]
为什么不看看我的商品呢？我有很多可能会让你感兴趣的东西~

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Praise be to Freya,
who watches over us,
and blesses us with
food and drink. Don't
you think that's great,
young adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
赞美守护我们并赐予我们饮食的芙蕾雅。年轻的冒险者，你不觉得这很棒吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Owning a lot of stuff
might seem great, but
many things aren't that
valuable when you think
of them in terms of
real emotional value.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
拥有很多东西看起来很棒，但如果从真正的情感价值来考虑，许多东西并没有那么有价值。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Well, that might have been
a dangerous remark when
I'm trying to sell things to
customers. Still, I wish
I could carry a wider
selection of goods.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
嗯，当我试图向顾客推销东西时，这可能是一句危险的话。不过，我还是希望能携带更多种类的商品。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Of course, we're here
in the middle of the desert,
so maybe I'm asking too much.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
当然，我们身处沙漠中心，也许我要求太多了。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey! Do you think
I can reach the bridge
over there if I jump
from over here? Do
you think you can try it?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿！你觉得如果我从这里跳过去，能到达那边的桥吗？你觉得你能试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
What?! You can't do it?
Well, I'm gonna be different
when I grow up! I'm gonna
be the world's best jumper!
I'm gonna be able to jump
all the way to the mooooon!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
什么？！你做不到？好吧，等我长大后我会变得不一样！我要成为世界上最好的跳跃者！我要能一直跳到月——球上去！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The clothes we make here
are high, airy, and sewn
with high quality fabric.
Of course, we need to wear
stuff like this since the
weather is unbearably hot.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我们这里制作的衣服宽松透气，用高质量的面料缝制。当然，我们需要穿这样的衣服，因为天气热得让人难以忍受。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The fabric? Well,
I'll give you a hint.
It's made of something
related to camels. Heh!
I'll leave you to figure it
out on your own. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
面料？嗯，我给你个提示。它是由与骆驼有关的东西制成的。呵！留给你自己去想吧。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Let me tell you a secret.
But promise not to tell
anyone else about it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
让我告诉你一个秘密。但答应不要告诉其他人，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
When the time comes,
the Temple of Cheshrumnir
will open up and the giant
Freya robot will launch!
It'll destroy every country
except Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
当时机到来时，瑟斯隆尼勒神殿将会开启，巨大的芙蕾雅机器人将会启动！它将摧毁除阿鲁纳菲兹以外的所有国家！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
That robot can blow
hurricanes from its mouth,
and shoot lightning from
its horns, and it can fire
its fists away, and its
chest is a flame thrower!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
那个机器人能从嘴里喷出飓风，从角上发射闪电，还能把拳头射出去，它的胸部是个火焰喷射器！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
..............................
You don't believe me, either.
What did you just say? Zinger?
Amazing Z? The hell's that?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
..............................
你也不相信我。你刚才说什么？Zinger？Amazing Z？那是什么鬼？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Argh! I'm a war god
protecting Goddess Freya
and Arunafeltz! Ahhhhh!
Death to all our enemies!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊！我是保护芙蕾雅女神和阿鲁纳菲兹的战神！啊啊啊啊！消灭所有敌人！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Burn, heretics, buuurn!
Destroy your homes, your
families, and build a new
perfect world for Freya!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
燃烧吧，异教徒，燃——烧！摧毁你们的家园，你们的家庭，为芙蕾雅建立一个全新的完美世界！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hee hee! Doesn't that
sound wonderful! When
I grow up, I wanna be
that kind of hero!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘻嘻！听起来是不是很美妙！等我长大后，我想成为那样的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Fr... Fr...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
芙……芙……

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Fr...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
芙……

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Praise Freya! ^333333*Keck*^000000
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 Fre...
^333333*Cough*^000000 Praise Freya!
Freya! Conquer those
that blaspheme you! Let
me see it before I die!

[Old Man]
I have never regretted
^333333*Cough*^000000 my faith in you,
my goddess! ^333333*Keck*^000000 May
the suffering of all our
enemies drive them to
madness before death!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我从未后悔^333333*咳*^000000对你的信仰，
我的女神！^333333*咳*^000000愿
所有敌人的痛苦驱使他们在死前陷入疯狂！

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I wonder what my
standing with Freya
is like. Hopefully, she
will take mercy upon me
when I leave this world.
My days here are numbered...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我不知道我在芙蕾雅心中的地位如何。希望当我离开这个世界时，她能对我施以怜悯。我在这里的日子屈指可数了……

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Huh? You don't live here.
Are you... Are you a traveler?
You musta been to so many
other places, huh? What
do they look like? I want to
travel too when I grow up~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯？你不住在这里。你是……你是旅行者吗？你一定去过很多其他地方吧？它们是什么样子的？等我长大后我也想去旅行~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I like this town, but I want
to see how other people live.
The grown-ups think it's a bad
idea, though. They say Freya
hates it. Is it that bad that
I can't stop wondering?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我喜欢这个城镇，但我想看看其他人是如何生活的。不过大人们认为这是个坏主意。他们说芙蕾雅讨厌这样。真的有那么糟糕吗？让我忍不住好奇？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh. You must be
sightseeing. Um,
Veins is a small town,
visit Cheshrumnir Temple?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦。你一定是在观光。嗯，
伯仁斯是个小镇，
要去参观瑟斯隆尼勒神殿吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I hope you enjoy
your stay. Now if
you'll excuse me, I'd
like to continue with
my prayers to Freya.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
希望你过得愉快。现在请原谅我，我想继续向芙蕾雅祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh, gracious Freya, your
servant humbly beseeches
you on bended knee...
Heal me of this infirmity!
The body is droopingly limp,
but the spirit is willing...!
must be... Cheshrumnir Temple.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦，仁慈的芙蕾雅，您的仆人跪地卑微恳求……
治愈我的病痛！
身体虽软弱无力，但精神是愿意的……！
一定是……瑟斯隆尼勒神殿。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
You know what's good
about the desert? No?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
你知道沙漠的好处是什么吗？不知道？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The desert makes you
stronger. Understand
what I mean? Heh, you'll
know as you spend more
time here in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
沙漠让你变得更强大。明白我的意思吗？呵，你在沙漠里待久了就会知道。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner]
Unbelievable!
What kind of country
is this?! How can you
lock me up just because
I don't believe in Freya?!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯]
难以置信！
这是什么国家？！你怎么能仅仅因为我不相信芙蕾雅就把我关起来？！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner]
This isn't civilized!
You're a bunch of savages
if you can't respect my
beliefs, you know that?
Someone, someone help!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯]
这不文明！
如果你不能尊重我的信仰，你们就是一群野蛮人，你知道吗？
来人啊，来人帮帮我！

scripts.text:
[Ward]
This place ensures that
dangerous criminals aren't
threatening the publi--
Wait. Why are you even
here?! This place isn't
safe for you! Leave!
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
这个地方确保危险的罪犯不会威胁公众——
等等。你为什么在这里？！这里对你来说不安全！离开！

scripts.text:
[Ward]
I'm grateful that our
town is relatively peaceful.
If it were any other place,
that tiny cell would be
crammed full of criminals.
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
我很感激我们镇相对和平。如果是其他地方，那个小牢房早就挤满了罪犯。

scripts.text:
[Ward]
Thank Freya that I've
been assigned to such
a peaceful, quiet place.
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
感谢芙蕾雅把我派到这样一个和平、安静的地方。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
I must study as hard as I can
for the grace of Goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
^333333*喘气 喘气*^000000
我必须为了芙蕾雅女神的恩典而努力研究。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I really believe that
I can serve Freya one of
these days if I can just
expand my knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我真的相信，只要我能扩展我的知识，总有一天我能侍奉芙蕾雅。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
It's too hot...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
太热了……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
So sweaty...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
全是汗……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Tricked you!
Thought I was dead,
didn't you? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
骗到你了！
以为我死了，对吧？哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The drinks in this
town are so... They're...
They're so damn strong!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个镇的酒太……它们……
它们太烈了！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Why...
Why does the ground
keep wobbling?! It's...
It's like it's trying to
betray me! Every time!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
为什么……
为什么地面一直在晃动？！它……
它就像是要背叛我！每次都是！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
^333333*Hiccup*^000000

[Towner]
It's nice when a town
is peaceful and quiet...
But it's lame when a
tavern is dead like this.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
城镇和平安静是好事……
但酒馆像这样死气沉沉就很没劲。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, there's good
and bad points to
everything. Hopefully
things will pick up
around here as more of
you adventurers come visit.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，凡事都有好坏两面。希望随着更多像你这样的冒险者来访，这里的生意会好转。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
There's nothing but
old people and children
in this town. Where's a
decent man worth marrying?
There's a few bachelors that
are my age, but... Well...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个镇上只有老人和孩子。哪里有价值嫁的好男人？有几个和我同龄的单身汉，但是……嗯……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
They're all too hairy or
too muscular. I don't think
I'll be able to get married
anytime soon! Oh, the misery!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
他们要么毛发太重，要么肌肉太发达。我想我短期内结不了婚了！哦，真悲惨！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, our town doesn't
have a choice but to
defend itself in dangerous
times. The young men we
have here are all buff and
tough to protect us.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，我们镇在危险时期别无选择，只能自卫。我们这里的年轻人都很强壮坚韧，以保护我们。

scripts.text:
[Town]
They may not be beautiful,
but they have kind and
gentle hearts. It's a pity
that the women here
are more concerned
with appearances.
scripts.translation:
[城镇]
他们可能不漂亮，但他们有善良温柔的心。可惜这里的女性更关注外表。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Don't judge a book
by its cover, but
by its contents.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
不要以貌取人，要看内涵。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
This storage solely
exists for serious drinkers.
If it's ever shut down,
I think everyone in town
will riot. Crazy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个仓库专为严肃的酒客存在。如果它关门了，我想全镇的人都会暴动。疯狂吧？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Veins is famous for its
wide variety of delicious,
irresistible liquor. Just one
sip's enough to hook you.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
伯仁斯以其种类繁多、美味诱人、令人无法抗拒的美酒而闻名。只需一口就足以让你上瘾。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Praise Freya for
blessing us with the
gift of awesome liquor.
Her graciousness, her
compassion, her liquor
is limitless. Let us pray.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
赞美芙蕾雅赐予我们美妙美酒的礼物。
她的恩惠，她的慈悲，她的美酒
是无限的。让我们祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I really want to
ask out the woman
right in front of me.
Do you think she'll...?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我真的很想约面前这位女士出去。你觉得她会……？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Crap! Did I say that
out loud? I-I-I really
didn't want her to hear!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
糟了！我说出声了吗？我-我-我真的不想让她听到！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I heard all that...
Gosh, he's so clueless.
I don't hate him, but he
should show a bit more
backbone if he wants
to impress me. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我都听到了……
天哪，他真是不开窍。
我不讨厌他，但如果他想给我留下印象，应该表现得更有骨气一点。嗯……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you enjoy a good,
stiff drink, then you have
to stop by Veins Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你喜欢喝烈酒，那你一定要来伯仁斯酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you don't love
drinking, then Veins
Tavern is the perfect
place to learn! ...To
love... drinking...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你不爱喝酒，那么伯仁斯酒馆是学习的好地方！……去
爱……喝酒……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Isn't the sun so hot?
Doesn't it make you feel
so thirsty? Well, you may
want to consider quenching
that nasty thirst with liquor!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
太阳是不是很热？
是不是让你觉得很渴？嗯，你可能想考虑用美酒来解那讨厌的渴！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
My job is to serve
delicious, life giving
liquor to my customers to
relieve their parched throats.
Seeing their drunken smiles
really makes my day~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我的工作是为顾客提供美味、赋予生命的美酒，以缓解他们干渴的喉咙。
看到他们醉醺醺的笑容真的让我一天都心情大好~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
A lone wolf of the desert.
That's me. Well, that's why
I'm drinking here alone.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
沙漠中的独狼。
那就是我。嗯，这就是为什么我独自在这里喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Sweet Freya, these
drinks are so good.
I could drink all day.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
甜美的芙蕾雅，这些酒真好喝。
我可以喝一整天。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Man, the world is just...
It's just desires...!
Faith? It helps, you
know? Cuz-cuz desires
are all just nothing!
They're nooooooothing!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
天哪，世界就是……
就是欲望……！
信仰？它有帮助，你
知道吗？因-因为欲望
都是虚无！
它们什么都不是！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Argh! What is life?!
I don't know what to
believe anymore! Freya!
Freya looooves you!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
啊！什么是生活？！
我不知道该相信什么了！芙蕾雅！
芙蕾雅爱——你！
